name: ZBS_REFERABLE_PRODUCTS
description: THIS TABLE STORES INFORMATION ABOUT THE RERERABILITY OF SALES REFERENCE CUSTOMER PRODUCTS

columns.name: REFERABLE_PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: PRIMARY KEY

columns.name: KEY_CONTACT_REL_ID
columns.description: MAP TO HZ_RELATIONSHIPS RELATIONSHIP_ID

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: PARTY ID OF REFERENCE CUSTOMER. MAPS TO HZ_PARTIES

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: MAPS TO EGP_ITEM_ORG_ASSOCIATIONS.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.description: MAPS TO EGP_ITEM_ORG_ASSOCIATIONS.ORGANIZATION_ID

columns.name: PROD_GROUP_ID
columns.description: PRODUCT GROUP ID

columns.name: REFERABLE_CODE
columns.description: INDICATES WHETHER THE PRODUCT OR PRODUCT GROUP IS REFERABLE

columns.name: KEY_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: PARTY ID OF KEY CONTACT

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: COMMENTS

columns.name: ROW_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: ROW TYPE:  PRODUCT OR PRODUCT GROUP ROW

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: INDICATES THE SOURCE OF DATA FOR THIS ROW

columns.name: LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: INDICATES IMPLEMENTATION STATUS OF PRODUCT OR PRODUCT GROUP AT CUSTOMER SITE

columns.name: HIDE_FLAG
columns.description: FLAG TO INDICATE WHETHER THIS RECORD SHOULD BE HIDDEN FROM A SALES REP

columns.name: REVN_AMT
columns.description: REVENUE REALIZED FOR THIS PRODUCT FOR THIS CUSTOMER

columns.name: REVN_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: REVN_CURRENCY_CODE

columns.name: QUANTITY_NUM
columns.description: QUANTITY OF PRODUCT PURCHASED BY CUSTOMER

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: UNIT OF MEASURE ASSOCIATED WITH THE QUANTITY COLUMN

columns.name: LAST_ORDER_DATE
columns.description: DATE OF LAST ORDER IN WHICH THE CUSTOMER PURCHASED THIS PRODUCT

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
